summary: Baileys fork resolves libsignal from an unpinned GitHub repository
details: This package is a fork of the WhatsApp library Baileys. Its package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:alannzxd/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash, so `npm install` clones whatever the default branch of that author-controlled repository currently contains — including any lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) it may carry — and executes them during install. The owner of that repository can change the served contents at any time without any change to this package. Additionally, lib/index.js performs a top-level import-time fetch to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alannzxd/xclient/refs/heads/main/information.json; the response body is only console-logged, but the request discloses installer IP and User-Agent to the author on every require.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
